claim: 垂直切片是本体量下最重要的门槛：20 分钟到 1 小时，但必须完整且抛光，不能有占位
source_title: Game Development Process: Keys for a Better Pipeline (GDKeys)
quote: A Vertical Slice takes a small slice of experience from the full game (20mn to 1h depending on the game): this slice will be as complete (no missing core feature or content) and as polished (no placeholders, first balancing) as possible.

claim: Vertical Slice 的作用是测试生产管线本身，而不只是验证想法
source_title: Milestones - Levelling The Playing Field (Rami Ismail)
quote: In the Vertical Slice the main goal is to test your production cycle.

claim: 独立项目的资金通常要在垂直切片结束时到位，否则团队会在几个月内耗尽资源或动力
source_title: Milestones - Levelling The Playing Field (Rami Ismail)
quote: Often, funding has to be completed by the end of the Vertical Slice, or your team will likely run out of resources (or motivation) within several months.

claim: Alpha（Feature Complete）通常出现在生产期的约三分之二处
source_title: Game Development Process: Keys for a Better Pipeline (GDKeys)
quote: I prefer the more straightforward term of “Feature Complete” and usually happens at around 2/3rd of the Production phase.

claim: 到 Alpha 必须能不靠开发者协助跑完一整遍，才能采集留存、节奏、时长等指标
source_title: Game Development Process: Keys for a Better Pipeline (GDKeys)
quote: By Feature Complete (or Alpha), you should be able to run your first full-playthrough playtests without much player assistance

claim: 最常见的流程失败是把预生产当成早期生产，提前进入内容量制作，然后在后面撞墙
source_title: Game Development Process: Keys for a Better Pipeline (GDKeys)
quote: too often, teams use Pre-Production as early Production, jumping into content creation and hitting walls later on

claim: 完整周期是八个阶段，上线后由长线运营继续延伸
source_title: What are the essential stages of full cycle game creation (Kokku Games)
quote: The eight stages are: concept, pre-production, vertical slice, production, alpha, beta, certification, and launch, with live ops extending the cycle well beyond ship date.
note: concept 阶段：独立项目数周到三个月，AAA 最多六个月

claim: 概念阶段：独立项目数周到三个月，AAA 项目最多六个月
source_title: What are the essential stages of full cycle game creation (Kokku Games)
quote: For indie projects, it runs weeks to three months. For AAA titles, expect up to six months.

claim: Beta（内容完成）应在发售前 8–12 周到达；AAA 大约在生产第九个月
source_title: What are the essential stages of full cycle game creation (Kokku Games)
quote: Beta should arrive 8 to 12 weeks before launch for smaller projects, and roughly nine months into production for a AAA pipeline.

claim: 进入 Beta 时构建不稳定是最常见失败，会压缩 QA 窗口并造成连锁延期
source_title: What are the essential stages of full cycle game creation (Kokku Games)
quote: The most common failure at this stage: teams enter beta with an unstable build.

claim: 先把核心“动词”（功能）锁定，后面的一切才可预测；内容是可以排期的，功能不行
source_title: Milestones - Levelling The Playing Field (Rami Ismail)
quote: The sooner we can lock in the core 'verbs', the more predictable everything else gets.

claim: 原型阶段本身可以淘汰项目：有些游戏永远走不过原型
source_title: Game Development Guide: How Games Are Made (CG Spectrum)
quote: Some games may never make it past this stage.

claim: 预生产通常占总制作时间的 20% 以内
source_title: Game Development Guide: How Games Are Made (CG Spectrum)
quote: typically takes up to 20% of the total production time

claim: Alpha 与 Beta 的区别是：Alpha 问“功能在不在、能不能用”，Beta 问“在真实条件下能不能出货”
source_title: Video game testing stages: alpha, beta, and release (Game-Ace)
quote: alpha asks whether the features exist and work; beta asks whether the product is shippable under real conditions

claim: 中型项目的 QA 节奏：Alpha 6–12 周，封闭+开放 Beta 4–10 周，RC 到 Gold 2–6 周
source_title: Video game testing stages: alpha, beta, and release (Game-Ace)
quote: On a mid-sized project, alpha runs 6–12 weeks, closed plus open beta 4–10 weeks, and release candidate to gold master 2–6 weeks.

claim: 育碧开放世界的 AAA 开发需要 400–600 人，分布在多个国家的多个工作室
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: 400 to 600 persons for open world games

claim: AA（双 A）工作室通常在 50–100 人规模
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: Double-A studios tend to range from 50 to 100 people in size.

claim: 2024–2025 年立项的 AAA 平均开发预算约 2 亿美元，2018 年是 5000 万–1.5 亿
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: AAA games that were greenlit for a potential release in 2024 and 2025 received an average development budget of $200 million and up an increase from an average of a $50 million to $150 million from 2018.
note: 来源为英国 CMA 报告

claim: 成本上升促使发行商只投成熟 IP，AAA 里实验性项目变少
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: the escalating cost of producing large-scale titles encouraged publishers to invest primarily in established franchises, leading to fewer experimental projects within the AAA space.

claim: 单款失败可能直接导致工作室关闭
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: The failure of a single game to meet production costs could lead to the failure of a studio

claim: AAA 是加班（crunch）问题最突出的环境之一
source_title: AAA (video game industry) — Wikipedia
quote: AAA game development has been identified as one environment where crunch time and other working pressures that negatively affect employees are particularly evident.

claim: 发行商没有耐心听“等做完就顺了”这类解释
source_title: Pitching Your Game in 2026: What Publishers Are Looking For (Mind Studios)
quote: Publishers don't have patience for "this will work better when it's finished" explanations.

claim: 试玩切片要在前 30 秒同时给出：清楚的玩法、稳定的性能、与最终一致的视觉风格
source_title: Pitching Your Game in 2026: What Publishers Are Looking For (Mind Studios)
quote: your vertical slice needs to nail three things in the first 30 seconds

claim: 发行商看试玩第一指标是留存曲线
source_title: What publishers actually look for in a playtest (FirstLook)
quote: Retention curves are the single most important metric

claim: 30 份非手游独立发行协议的均值：预付 31.8 万美元；只看有预付的协议则 46 万；区间 10 万–200 万
source_title: Game Publisher Agreement Guide for Indie Studios (Promise Legal)
quote: the average advance to fund a game is $318,000. Counting only deals with an advance, the average rises to $460,000. The lowest advance in the dataset was $100,000 and the highest was $2 million.
note: 原始数据：Voyer Law 在 GDC Summer 收集的 30 份协议

claim: 平均分成是开发者 60/发行商 40；无预付的协议开发者拿 71%，有预付的只有 55%
source_title: Game Publisher Agreement Guide for Indie Studios (Promise Legal)
quote: the average split gives developers 60 percent and publishers 40 percent. That rises to 71 percent for developers in no-advance deals

claim: 42% 的协议要求预付全额回收后开发者才拿到第一笔分成
source_title: Game Publisher Agreement Guide for Indie Studios (Promise Legal)
quote: Voyer's data showed that 42 percent of deals require the advance to be fully recouped before developers see a single dollar.

claim: 发行协议常把资金绑在里程碑上，发行商可以用“验收不通过”拖延付款并要求改需求
source_title: Game Publisher Agreement Guide for Indie Studios (Promise Legal)
quote: A publisher can withhold acceptance (and therefore payment) for reasons that have nothing to do with the quality of your build, using the milestone process as leverage

claim: 预付回收期（pre-recoup）的分成从 0/100 到 50/50，0/100 越来越常见
source_title: Upfronts, Guarantees, Recoups (Rami Ismail)
quote: **0/100** Increasingly common, publishers do not pay out any revenue to developers until they've fully recouped their investment.

claim: 回收完成后的分成最常见是 50/50（上下 10%）
source_title: Upfronts, Guarantees, Recoups (Rami Ismail)
quote: **~50/50** The most common post-recoup revenue share at the time of writing seems to be the 50/50 split, give or take 10%

claim: 在回收期内，平台拿到的钱可能多于开发者
source_title: Upfronts, Guarantees, Recoups (Rami Ismail)
quote: the platform is making more revenue from the title than the developer
note: 原例：20 万美元预算、70% 回收，总流水约 40.8 万时开发者约 8.5 万，平台约 12.2 万

claim: 首发周销量/wishlist 的中位数是 0.17x，但区间从 1 倍到 10 倍
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: The median was 0.17x if you launched with >10k wishlists (so: 50k wishlists, 8,500 total sales at end of Week 1), but it was as low as 10% of that, and as high as 10x that.

claim: 只算首发时 wishlist 超过 2.5 万的游戏，中位数降到 0.15x
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: Looking only at games with >25k wishlists at launch, it's a median of 0.15x

claim: 只算售价高于 10 美元的游戏，中位数进一步降到 0.10x
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: we see a median drop all the way down to 0.10x

claim: 转化差的那批游戏，上市 7 天后的中位好评率只有 67%（Mixed），而转化最好的 20 款是 91%
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: The median Steam player review score of these games is 67% (Mixed) after 7 days, compared to 91% (Very Positive) for the select Top 20.

claim: 滞销游戏平均在 Steam 挂了 411 天才发售，高转化组只挂了 214 天
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: an average of 411 days on Steam before launching
note: 说明：页面上停留过久≈关注度衰减

claim: 买量来的 wishlist 质量更差，转化成销量更弱
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: the wishlists from ads were of worse quality
note: 该刊转述 Furnish Master 开发者复盘原话

claim: 没有证据表明 wishlist→销量 的转化率在整体下滑，变化的是游戏数量变多
source_title: The state of Steam wishlist 'conversions': 2024-2025 (GameDiscoverCo)
quote: we don't think they are slipping, according to this data

claim: 免费 Demo + Next Fest 是这套漏斗里最大的单个杠杆（Timberborn：10 万人试玩，三周 +9.1 万 wishlist）
source_title: Deep Dive: How we got one million players to give a dam about Timberborn (Game Developer)
quote: we were up 91,000 wishlists. We were overjoyed.
note: 同文：发售前累计 26.1 万 wishlist，首周 13 万份

claim: Early Access 不是众筹手段
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: Early Access is not a way to crowdfund development of your product.

claim: 没有可玩内容就不该开 EA（只有技术演示太早）
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: Don't launch in Early Access without a playable game.

claim: EA 阶段不许对未来做具体承诺
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: Do not make specific promises about future events.

claim: EA 期间拿不到完整的首发曝光，正式发布才有
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: you will not receive your full launch visibility until you are fully released

claim: EA 超过 12 个月没更新，Steam 会在商店页加“很久没更新”的提示
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: If it has been more than 12 months (one year) since the developers of an Early Access game have updated the game
note: 同时满足“未更新构建”或“未发更新公告”

claim: 涨价后 30 天内不能打折，包括从 EA 转正式版的发售折扣
source_title: Early Access — Steamworks Documentation
quote: you will not be able to run a discount within 30 days following a price increase

claim: Valve 自己的经验是大型内容更新间隔最多 1–2 个月
source_title: Updating Your Game - Best Practices — Steamworks
quote: We have found that for our own games it works best to release major updates every 1-2 months at most.

claim: Valve 建议读反馈与社区责任归开发团队，而不是外包给 PR 或社区经理
source_title: Updating Your Game - Best Practices — Steamworks
quote: reading feedback and being responsible for the community should be part of the dev team's role, rather than delegated out to community managers or a separate PR team

claim: 差评轰炸分两类：跑题的（Valve 会剔除，分数恢复）与切题的（全额计入，只能靠解决问题恢复）
source_title: Steam Review Bombing: How It Works, How to Survive (SteamPageAnalyzer)
quote: Off-topic bomb
note: 同表：Off-topic 不计分、On-topic 全额计入

claim: 所有有记录的恢复案例，第一步都是解决问题本身，而不是做公关解释
source_title: Steam Review Bombing: How It Works, How to Survive (SteamPageAnalyzer)
quote: Every documented recovery starts with the grievance being resolved, not messaged around.

claim: 索尼在 3 天内反转决定，近期评价在一周内翻回正面
source_title: Steam Review Bombing: How It Works, How to Survive (SteamPageAnalyzer)
quote: Sony reversed in 3 days and the recent score flipped back within a week.
note: 指 Helldivers 2 强制绑定 PSN 事件

claim: 跑题的差评轰炸由 Valve 标记后整体剔除，分数立即完全恢复
source_title: Steam Review Bombing: How It Works, How to Survive (SteamPageAnalyzer)
quote: Off-topic bomb, excluded: recovery is instant and complete.
